_comment: Opening hours, closing hours, and the best time to be somewhere.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The stops already carried closures as prose in their
`winter` text — 'Closed Sunday and Monday'. A person can read that; a planner
cannot. To say 'you reach Memphis on a Tuesday and the Civil Rights Museum is
shut', the same fact has to be data. This is that, kept separate from
stops.json so the two can be edited without fighting.
SCHEMA, per stop id
open    'HH:MM' local, when the doors open
close   'HH:MM' local, when they shut. Later than open, always.
closed  [weekday]  0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday. Days it does not open at all.
shut    ['MM-DD'] specific dates it is closed, for the holidays this trip
runs straight through.
best    when to actually be there, one of:
dark    only works after sunset — neon, lights, farolitos
golden  the hour before sunset, for canyons and painted metal
morning gates close early, or it sells out, or the light is east
early   go before the crowd or the parking fills
lunch   a lunch-only kitchen
evening it is a night out, not a stop
omitted where any open hour is as good as another.
why     one line saying why that is the best time, shown to the reader.
24-hour places carry open 00:00 / close 23:59 so the arithmetic stays simple.
A stop missing from this file is not 'always open' — it is UNCHECKED, and the
planner says so rather than inventing hours. Roughly half the list is checked;
the rest were never verified and must not be guessed.

pyrenees-cafe.why: A long communal table is a dinner, not a pit stop.

aji-amarillo.why: A swap-meet stall that shuts early.

calico.why: Gates shut at five and the mesa wind gets worse through the afternoon.

snow-cap.why: Winter hours are unreliable — they post closures on Facebook.

oatman.why: Before eleven or there is nowhere to park.

puebla-sunrise.why: Breakfast and lunch only. It has to shape your morning.

bearizona.why: Last entry well before dusk, and the animals are livelier in the cold.

walnut-canyon.why: The trails close an hour before the gate.

sunset-crater.why: A 35-mile loop road with no lighting and nowhere to turn round after dark.

grand-canyon.why: The rim is open all night, but the canyon only has depth in low sun.

wigwam-motel.why: Free to look, and the neon comes on at dusk.

meteor-crater.why: Brutally windy on the rim, and it builds through the day.

petrified-forest.why: Gates shut at five. Morning or nothing.

laguna-mission.why: An active community. Often closed, and the rules are strict.

old-town-abq.why: The farolitos are the reason to come, and they need the dark.

blue-hole.why: You are looking down into it, so it wants sun overhead.

blue-swallow.why: It is a neon strip. Dark falls by five in December, so this is easy to catch.

cadillac-ranch.why: Always open, and the paint photographs best in low sun.

u-drop-inn.why: The exterior is the whole thing, and it is lit at night.

delvins.why: Closes at four most days. Lunch, not dinner.

palo-duro.why: The canyon walls turn colour in the last hour, and the gate is at six.

edge-craft.why: They sell out. The line forms before the door opens.

bricktown.why: Built for evenings. At noon it is an empty canal.

beale-street.why: Three blocks of live music. Pointless before dark.

civil-rights-museum.why: It needs three unhurried hours, and it is heavy going. Do not do it tired.

broadway-nashville.why: Bands from late morning, but it is a night out.

arnolds.why: Locals fill it by five past eleven. Lunch or never.

skybridge.why: Closes for high wind. Check before driving in.

dollywood.why: The Christmas lights are the point, and they need the dark.

georgia-aquarium.why: Holiday week is its busiest of the year. Go at opening.

black-mountain.why: A small town that goes hard on Christmas lights.

saborcito-nica.why: Opens mid-afternoon and the hours run optimistic. Call first.

concord-mills.why: Holiday-week crowds are brutal. Mornings are survivable.

eagles-restaurant.why: Lunch only, and the line moves fast.

birmingham-civil-rights.why: Last entry is an hour before closing.

vicksburg.why: A 16-mile loop road, last car in at 4:40.

caddo-lake.why: Boat tours run in the calm part of the day and need booking.

marshall-lights.why: A light festival. Evening only, and it ends around the 28th.

bellingrath.why: Magic Christmas in Lights runs five till nine. The daytime garden is a different ticket.

french-quarter.why: Iron balconies and buskers. It comes alive after dark, and parking is easier once the day trade leaves.

la-state-capitol.why: Closes at four, and the observation deck wants clear light.

fritanga-gueguense.why: A truck. Opens mid-afternoon, and phone service out there is spotty.

la-carreta.why: A small room that fills fast. Go at an off hour.

galleria.why: Holiday-week crowds are the worst of the year.

sam-houston-statue.why: The statue is always there; the visitor centre shuts at five.

waco-mammoth.why: Dig shelter tours run every half hour, last one at 4:15.

la-chavala.why: Weekends it opens at ten; weekdays not until mid-afternoon.

copper-breaks.why: A certified dark sky park. The longhorns are a daytime bonus; the sky is the reason.

seven-magic-mountains.why: Fluorescent boulders in empty desert. Low sun, and no shade at midday.

hoover-dam.why: The crest walk is free and open early; the interior tours are ticketed and later.

vegas-strip.why: Fountains, neon and the volcano. There is no daytime version of this.

valley-of-fire.why: Red sandstone, sunrise to sunset, and the colour is all in the low light.
